description: The Star Festival has come to Lantarna. To commemorate friendship with the Rara Kingdom, Deona will perform a special song. However, when it's revealed as a new chapter of Yuna's Adventure Series, it exposes a surprisingly candid side of Yuna!? What could Deona be plotting...!
name: Twinkle Sparkle Star Festival! Story
Twinkle Sparkle Star Festival! Score Battle
Twinkle Sparkle Star Festival! Boss Battle

description: Monsters have stolen all the presents Resna made for her friends! Roman suddenly announces a special Star Festival event - whoever defeats the monsters gets to keep the presents they drop. Let's all hunt down those monsters!
name: Reclaim the Presents! Star Festival Battle

description: As Lantarna welcomes the new year, Saskia reflects alone on the events of the past year. Giving charms to her companions. Having them draw fortunes. Days filled with smiles. She makes a wish - that the new year brings happiness to everyone.
name: Bonds that Bind, Path of Stars Story
Bonds that Bind, Path of Stars Score Battle
Bonds that Bind, Path of Stars Boss Challenge

description: Something sparkly has fallen on the Floating Tower! These must be gifts from the heavens early in the new year - they're bound to bring good fortune!? Let's hurry and collect them!
name: Happy New Year! Treasure Dungeon!

description:
Wanting to eat meat is a source of worry.
Wanting to eat sweets is also a source of worry.
The world is overflowing with worries. But we can't let these worries follow us into the new year!
Come on, let's take out all our worries on the monsters!
name: Beat Away Your Worries!

description: Traveling across the Lantarna continent, Firis has been helping solve various people's problems. As whispers of her being a "genius" begin to spread, a young girl rushes into the atelier, indignant that anyone else would be called a genius besides herself. She is Ilmeria, a self-proclaimed first-class genius alchemist. However, she had no idea that she was about to be caught up in an unbelievable commotion--.
name: Walking Towards the Future with Friends Story
Walking Towards the Future with Friends Score Battle
Walking Towards the Future with Friends Boss Challenge

description: Firis and Ilmeria are both friends and rivals. While they acknowledge each other's alchemy skills, Ilmeria is shocked to hear that Firis was on the front lines during the Weltex incident. Not wanting to fall behind Firis in combat ability either, Ilmeria challenges her to a monster hunting competition...!
name: Mysterious Event ② Story
Special Score Battle: Dream With You
Special Boss Challenge: Dream With You

description: On the eve of the Linde Festival, where people give chocolate to their loved ones, the alchemist Sophie makes a promise with Plachta to exchange chocolates. To prepare her own special chocolate, Sophie heads into town with Plachta as the festivities begin. During her interactions with various people, what kind of chocolate will Sophie discover is truly her own...?
name: Special Story: Dream With You

description: The alchemist Ryza, with help from her close friend Klaudia, sets out to develop new products to sell at the Linde Festival. As they walk through town under the guise of product research, they learn about various types of gifts. While Ryza ponders what to give Klaudia, she discovers a special gift that only she can create...

Feeling a bit lonely, Alvina hopes the sleepover will help bridge the distance that has grown between her and Janne, bringing back memories of their childhood together...
